layers.name: complete-pole
layers.role: Uninterrupted complete painted pole, finial, collars, shaft and base. Full paint remains behind mounted head and junction box.

layers.name: complete-head
layers.role: Complete painted bracket, mounting plate, neck, hood and smoked glass assembly. Internal pieces are NOT independently editable geometry.

layers.name: junction-box
layers.role: Independent complete painted closed electronics box. Back surface and physical depth are not supplied.

method: Three independently editable neutral 2.5D raster layers, exact pixel crops and uniform scale plus translation. No relighting, recoloring, inpainting, vector overlays or inferred pan frames.
alphaPolicy: Provider RGBA retained verbatim. Crops preserve all subject-region alpha>=16 pixels, retain original alpha values inside crop, and discard only dispersed alpha1-15 pixels outside padding. Threshold16 is diagnostic only and never applied to render pixels.
limits: Uniform pole fit matches reference height, but generated base is proportionally wider. No nonuniform squeeze conceals this difference.
Three raster layers, not a 16-part or full 3D editable source.
Painted light and internal contours are baked within each complete raster component.
No production registration, collision, field, owner acceptance or native capture claim.
